dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Could we improve the naming of this variable?
dialogue.zh: 我们能改进这个变量的命名吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. A descriptive name should explain what the value represents.
dialogue.zh: 可以。清楚描述含义的名称应当说明这个值代表什么。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I will rename it to match its purpose. Could you take the keyboard and show me your suggestion?
dialogue.zh: 我会改成符合用途的名称。你能接过键盘演示一下你的建议吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure. Let us keep the naming consistent across the module.
dialogue.zh: 当然。我们让整个模块的命名保持一致吧。

dialogue_storage: PicLex 关键词标签 learning.example/exampleChinese 保存 canonical A,B,A,B 4 话轮对白（A=学习者朗读评分，B=机器朗读不评分，角色标记不朗读）；角色说明仅保留在 cards.roles 元数据；cards.targets 各词 example_en/example_zh 仍为定稿摘录。
communication_goal: 说明命名问题、提出修改并保持一致性。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure developers doing pair code review at a desk with one monitor. A large separate PHYSICAL KEYBOARD with an orderly grid of small unlettered key shapes lies clearly visible at the desk front-right, no hands over it. Left developer listens; right reviewer reaches toward keyboard but hand stays beside it. Screen contains abstract rows without code or letters. Entire keyboard unobstructed.

coverage_review.scope: W045 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W045.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：纯黑背景白色火柴人线稿，单幅双人工作沟通场景、底图无文字；桌面前侧完整独立键盘可定位。 其余3词仅以明确对白支持，不虚构局部框。 局部裁剪复查后扩大右/下边界，保护完整道具。
